body.heading: What it does
paragraphs: A small business gets messages and comments on several platforms at once and misses half of them. The unified inbox gathers them into one list, filtered by platform and status, with a reply drafted by AI from the brand's Playbook ready to edit and send.

body.heading: My part
paragraphs: I scoped it, built much of the front end on desktop and phone, and released it. A teammate built most of the backend.
